description: Nine recorded searches across English, Armenian and Russian generic/date-window/sector/geographic terms did not surface a qualifying in-country protest. Most returned results were misdated April–June 2024 or unrelated; this is a bounded open-web search, not evidence that no event occurred.
required_followup: Continue local Armenian reporting, regional sources and event-specific searches; inspect contemporaneous records not indexed by open search.

description: A February 24 search snippet refers to a diaspora rally outside Armenia’s consulate in Glendale, California. The country-unit treatment of a diaspora action and exact demand/threshold remain unresolved; it is not counted as a domestic Armenian event.
required_followup: If scope policy includes diaspora events, obtain direct public evidence and review country/location ownership; do not silently map this foreign-location action to Armenia.

description: Open-web retrieval does not reproduce LexisNexis. Exact rendered search strings were preserved; native metadata remains unavailable. Search results were weakly date-aligned and no absence claim is supportable.
required_followup: Use systematic contemporary archives and local-language coverage in follow-up.
